title: Work Card Validation, Close, and Next-Candidate Return
executionReleaseCondition: WC12 is accepted and the Operator explicitly releases WC13.
purpose: Create Operator Validation Records only after validation, derive Work Card close from an Approved record, and return to Phase Building for the next eligible candidate.
validationEntryRequirements: Current implementation path has an Approved Implementer Report
All required pre-validation repairs have Approved reports
No unresolved RevisionRequested or Rejected Implementer Report exists
attemptNumberingRule: Derive the next sequential attempt number from existing validation records for the parent Work Card.
validationRecordRequiredFields: Parent Work Card ID and path
Latest applicable repair ID and report

dispositionMeanings.RevisionRequested: Operator validation failed and repair is required
dispositionMeanings.Rejected: Operator declines or abandons acceptance; parent Work Card unresolved

closeRule: Current implementation or latest repair Implementer Report is Approved
Latest applicable Validation Record references that implementation evidence
returnTarget: Phase / Building through WC09 candidate selection
prohibitedScope: Separate Work Card closeout or approval artifacts
Phase Validation, Phase Close, Project Validation, or Project Close
Route tokens, execution runs, role gates, or hash gates
Provider APIs, DOM automation, credential extraction
